## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: In _check_cache_usage, the condition 'cache_read <= prev_cache_read' on turn > 0 can emit a spurious advisory warning during multi-turn cache warming: if turn 0 returns cache_creation=100 and cache_read=0 (function returns 0 as prev), and turn 1 also has cache_read=0 (still warming), the condition 0 <= 0 fires the warning even though cache is still being built rather than read.
File: plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py:165
Category: correctness
data.title: dispatch.py: _check_cache_usage may emit false-positive warning during multi-turn cache warming
